༈rab tu spros med kyi dbang bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: rab tu spros med kyi dbang bzhugs/ bya bral lhun rdzogs rang la phyag 'tshal lo/ /da ni rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang sems kyi mtshan nyid mngon sum du ston pa bshad par bya'o/ / gong du dbang gsum rdzogs pa'i skyes bu la/ snga dro dang po mchod pa dang gtor ma bsham/ maṇḍal mnyam zhing zlum po la/ gser gyi tshom bu bkod la bla ma la dbul/ ye shes kyi snang ba bskyed pa'i don du bla ma shar du blta/ 'jig rten gyi snang ba nub pa'i phyir slob ma nub tu bltas te/ bde lugs su 'dug la/ shes pa gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu sems nyid skye ba med pa'i don mngon du rtogs par bya'o snyam du bya/ de nas bla mas bu khyod su yin zhes dris pas slob mas lan du/ bdag skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig pu lags zhes lan gsum mo/ /yang bla mas/ de ltar yin phan chad sems nyid gdod ma nas skye ma myong ba'-i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs shig /ces bya'o/ / de nas bla ma la phyag 'tshal te gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye ma rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ / bdag la rab tu dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni khams gsum 'khor gnas su/ /yun ring gnas pas dran nyams te/ /'khor ba nyid las brgal don du/ /bla ma la yang zhu ba bgyid/ /bskal pa brgya phrag du mar ni/ /bdag ni yang nas yang 'khor bas/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang byung ye shes nyid/ / rmang dang rtsa ba bcad pas sangs rgyas sems las byung*/ /sems kyi dam pa bdag la bstan du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ de nas lus cha bsrang*/ thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma la sems gtad de shes pa ma yengs par sems rtse gcig tu 'dzin du gzhug go /de nas rnam rtog gnas pa'i mtshams su bla mas glo bur du drag shul dang bcas pas 'di skad brjod sems gang yin zhes lan gsum mo/ /de la shes pa'i nyams myong ni/ /'di yin 'di min tshad med pa/ /brjod par dka' ba'i don de ni/ /slob ma'i rgyud la skye bar 'gyur/

/gnas skabs 'dir rnam rtog 'das pa 'gags/ ma 'ongs pa ma skyes/ da ltar gyi shes pa gsal la mi rtog pa/ skad cig ma'i ngos bzung*/ phyi yul snang*/ nang phung po/ bar dbang po la rtog pas btsal kyang ma rnyed/ skye ba med cing 'gag pa med pa'i shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ngos bzung nas 'jog pa ni dbang gi dngos gzhi ste/ 'dis sems kyi dri ma sbyong zhing*/ bzhi pa lhan cig skyes pa khregs chod du skye ba'i phyir/ de nas lung bstan pa'i slob ma shar du bltar bcug la seng ge lta bu'i 'dug stangs pus mo cung zad sa la phab/ rkang mthil mnyam par bya/ lag pa pus mo'i phyi logs su btsugs nas/ 'phongs yid tsam phyir phyung sgal tshigs drang bar byas te/ yid la chos nyid skye ba med pa byas nas/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig pu/ khyod shar phyogs na mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyasas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya ba/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal bas gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der glang po che'i lta stangs kyis ltos la seng ge'i mchongs stabs kyis song zhig /a a zhes rgyas gdab bo/ /yang lhor glang po che'i gdug stangs ni pus mo sa la gtad la/ lag pa gnyis gru mo pus mo'i mdun du btsugs/ mgo pus mo'i steng du dun ne byas la/ lag mthil gnyis kyis 'gram pa cung zad brtan mig smin mtshams lhor bltar bcug la/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod lho phyogs na dpal dang ldan pa zhes bya bas mdzes zhing yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan zhes bya ba/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing*/

rang rang gi 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal bas/ gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ / bu khyod der song seng ge'i lta stangs kyis ltos la/ stag mo'i mchongs stabs kyis song zhig /a a zhes brjod do/ /yang nub tu drang srong gi 'dug stangs ni skyil krung sa la tsog pur byas la gru mo pus mo'i steng du byas nas/ lag pa gnyis 'gram pa'i zur la brten nas lus bsrang ste nub phyogs su bltas la/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu khyod nub phyogs na padma brtsegs pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das snang ba mtha' yas shes bya ba/ rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba/ gsang sngags ky-i de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der dpal chen po'i rngam stabs kyis ltos la/ khyung nam mkhar lding ba'i 'gros kyis song zhig /a a a zhes brjod do/ /yang byang du bya rgod kyi spungs stangs ni/ rkang pa gnyis mnyam par mthil la sbyar la/ lag pa'i mthil pus mo'i steng du byas/ gru mo gnyis mkhal du bzhag ste/ rked pa bsrangs mig mdun phyogs su bltas te/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma skal ldan sems ky-i bu khyod 'di nas byang phyogs na las rab yongs su grub pa zhes bya ba'i zhing khams mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba na/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gdon mi za ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba rang rang gi ston pa las chos nyan cing*/ rang rang gi nye 'khor la chos ston pa/ rang rang gi sems kyi dam pa 'od gsal ba/ gsang sngags kyi de kho na nyid ston to/ /bu khyod der rdo rje 'chang gi lta stangs kyis ltos la/ klog dmar 'khyug pa'i stangs stabs kyis song zhig /a a a zhes rgyas gdab bo/

/de rnams kyi don ni/ shar na rab tu dkar ba'i gzugs dang*/ 'od kyis rab tu 'khrugs pa/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu'i kha dog gis mdzes shing 'od 'phro ba/ mngal gyi grong khyer du mi 'jug par/ rdzus te skyes nas lo lnga brgya dag na chos nyid la bar do med par sangs rgya bar nges te/ shar du sprul sku'i zhal mthong*/ lhor yon tan bslabs/ nub tu lung bstan/ byang du las dang bag chags kyi mtha' zad nas sangs rgyas pa ni/ rang shar nas kyang*/ /lnga brgya dag ni nges par byed/ /ces 'byung bas 'di thob pa'i yon tan yin no/ /de nas dbus kyi ni slob ma rdo rje skyil krung du 'dug la mnyam par bzhag te/ bla mas 'di skad brjod do/ /e ma skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig pu khyod nyon cig /de dag thams cad 'das pa'i pha rol na rgyan thams cad yongs su bkod pa zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams ye shes lngas khyab cing gsal ba/ rab tu mnyam zhing mi g.yo ba nyid na de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi mchog tu gyur ba'i ston pa/ dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba 'khor yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa rnams kyis bskor ba/ sems nyid mngon par 'dus ma byas pa mngon par rol pa zhig yod kyis/ bu khyod der glang po che'i zlum po lta stangs kyis ltos dbyings shig / seng ge'i mchongs thad kar stabs kyis song zhig rig pa/ khyung gyen nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis sku 'dug la drang srong gi 'dug mdun stangs kyis gnas par gyis 'dor stabs/ shig /glang po che'i thur nyal thabs kyis nyol thig le zhig / lcags sdong gi 'dril gnyes dril stabs kyis 'dril mu khyud

zhig /skyes bu'i rgyangs stabs kyis rkyongs ye shes shig /wa mo'i zur sems zur gyi 'gros kyis song dbyings rig bu zhig /bya rgod ky-i spungs stangs kyis spungs zhing khams shig / g.yon gyad kyi 'dor stabs kyis sa nyan thos non cig / g.yas 'bu srin gyi nur 'gros sa la 'chag par gyis nga rgyal shig /stag dred mo'i mchongs stabs kyis rtsal sbyongs byang sems shig/yang sems nyid gnas pa'i gzhi zungs shig /sems brtan pa'i gnas tshugs shig /sems nyid 'gyu bas rtsal sbyongs shig /sems nyid khyab pas rtags tshol zhig /sems nyid myur ba las zlos shig /sems nyid ma 'dres par shan phyes shig /sems nyid 'phen pas slar ma ldog cig / slar ma ldog cig /slar ma ldog cig /ces pas skye ba med pa'i dbyings su lam bstan pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'-i sa thob par 'gyur ro/ /de dag gi don ni/ rgyan yongs su bkod pa ni rig pa tshad phebs kyi zhing khams dbyings rig rdzogs pa yin la/ de ye shes lngas khyab pa'i snang ba yin zhing rtog pas g.yo ba med pa'o/ /rnal 'byor pas der phyin nas chos thams cad zad pa'i dbyings su phyin pa ni/ de bzhin nyid du gshegs pas de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa ni thugs rje 'gag pa med pa'o/ /skyes bu 'dul ba la sogs pa ni de nyid kyi yon tan yin no/ /'od dpag tu med pa ni nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /'khor sangs rgyas dpag tu med pa ni rig pa'i sku dpag tu med pa yang yin la/ sems can thams cad kyang de nyid kyi snying po can du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /sems nyid mngon par 'du ma byas pa ni tshogs brgyad gnas gyur pa shin tu rnam par dag pa'i chos te/ gnas dang ston pa dang 'khor dang chos thams cad gcig tu rtogs pa ni dus te/ de ltar sems dang ye shes mthar phyin pa'i don bshad pa'o/ /de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir gnad 'ching ba ni lus gnad lnga ste/

glang po che'i 'dug stangs kyis gzhi gcun/ seng ge'i 'dug stangs kyis lus gcun/ drang srong gi 'dug stangs kyis mig gcun/ bya rgod kyi spungs stangs kyis snang ba yul dang bsre/ rdo rje skyil krungad gis spros med du bzla'o/ /gzhan gyi spyod lam rnams bzhi thams cad kyang 'dug stangs kyi yan lag go /de la ra ི ga pa mngon sum gcun pa'i lta stangs bcu gnyis yod pa ni/ 'di lta ste/ glang po che'i lta stangs kyis gyen du bltas na dbyings rnam dag sgron ma mthong bar byed do/ /seng ge'i mchongs stabs ni der sdod pa ma yin te/ thams cad la bltas la rig pa lu gu rgyud la lta ba'o/ khyung nam mkha' la lding ba'i 'gros kyis nam mkha' thams cad du bltas te bzung ba'o/ /drang srong ni mi 'gyur bar brtan par bya ba'i thad kar mi 'gyur bar byed pa'o/ /glang chen nyal thabs ni snang ba de dang ma bral bar nyal bas gnyid log kyang thig le mthong ba'o/ /lcags sdong 'dril stangs ni mig gnyis ka'i mthar bltas na mu khyud kyi 'od brtan par byed pa'o/ /skyes bu'i rkyang thabs ni g.yas g.yon steng 'og phyogs mtshams su khrid pas snang ba mched par byed pa'o/ /wa mo'i zur 'gros ni mig gi zur nas nang du bsdus te bltas pas rig pa nang du 'char ba'o/ /bya rgod spungs stangs n-ii yul snang dang dbyings bsres nas lta bar byed pas zhing khams mthong ba'o/ /gyad ni srid pa dang zhi ba gnyis ka la mi gnas pa'-i don du snang stong dbyer med du bsre ba'o/ /'bu srin ni yul drug dang yul can thams cad zhib tu phye nas dbyings dang shes rab kyis bsres pas rten 'brel mthong ba rang rgyal mthong ba'o/ /stag mo'i mchongs stabs ni/ thod rgal gyi nyams len dang khregs cha ོ da gnyis phar len tshur len byas pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam shes pa'i phyir bstan te/ de rnams ni rig pa sbyong ba'i thabs so/

/de nas yang sems sbyong ba ni/ dang po gnas pa btsal/ bstan par bya/ rnam rtog 'gyu ba rtsal sbyang*/ yul thams cad bsre/ de skad cig mar blta/ shes rab kyis spang gnyen dbye/ 'du byed kyis 'phangs pa'i las rgyun bcad pas/ dang po nyon mongs su ma ldog /gnyis pa gnyen po ru ma ldog /gsum pa spros bral gyi zhen par ma ldog /ces lan gsum bstan pas sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro/ /don bshad pa rgyud rgyab yig bla ma'i man ngag bsgrigs so/ /de nas gtor ma gtang*/ tshogs la longs spyad/ dga' ston ci 'byor bya'o/ /de nas nyi ma gsum tsam lta stangs la ngo sprad de/ nyams su len du gzhug go /'di ni khams gsum las grol bar byed pa'i gdams ngag yang dag pa'o/ /rab tu spros pa med pa'i dbang gi phyag len/ sprul pa po dga' rab rdo rjes mdzad pa dang*/ bla ma rnams kyi rgyab yig go sla zhing lag len bde bar bya ba'i phyir/ rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa'o/ /dam pa'i gdams ngag mi 'gal bar/ /rang byung rdo rjes bsdus pa la/ /nyes pa'i tshogs rnams gang mchis pa/ /bka' srung mkha' 'gros bzod par mdzod/ slob ma mchog rnams kyis yang yang bskur ba'i phyir/ yi ge thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa shin tu lag len bde bar yod do// /rdzogs so// // maṅga laṃ/ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (3)rab tu spros med kyi dbang*/ -PAGE 360--PAGE 359--PAGE 353-
